newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wells Gardner begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wells Gardner begun with buy.

text.p: --National Securities Corp said Monday it initiated coverage of video monitor manufacturer Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp with a buy rating.

--Price target is $8-$10, based on 1997 earnings estimate of $0.37 a share and 1998 estimate of $0.60 a share, National Securities analyst Steven Kornfeld said in a research report. The company reported a loss of $0.15 a share in 1995. The stock was untraded Monday and closed Thursday at 3-1/2.
--"New management has recognized the need to enter higher margin service, intranet, and other value-added markets," Kornfeld said.
--"Cash flow achieved through its market leadership positions will enable entry into businesses," Kronfeld said.
